content.what_it_is: MATLAB postprocessing script for the FUNWAVE-TVD surface_wave_1d case: plots solitary-wave surface elevation snapshots over a reconstructed 1-D beach profile. Reconstructs the bathymetry analytically rather than loading it: m=1024 points at dx=1.0 (L4-5), flat 10.0 m depth (L11), and for x > Xslp=750.0 a plane slope dep = 10.0-(x-Xslp)*SLP with SLP=0.05 (L12). For each snapshot index in files=[1 6 11 17] (L16) it loads eta_<5-digit index> from the hardcoded directory /Users/fengyanshi15/tmp1/ (L2, L25) and draws one subplot per snapshot (4x1, L27): bottom profile -dep in black and eta in blue (L29), fixed axis [0 1024 -1.5 1.5] (L31), labels x(m)/eta(m) (L33-34), and a title computing time as files(num)*10 sec (L35). Figure is sized 6x8 inches via gcf properties (L18-20). A comment header '% wavemaker and sponge' (L14) is followed by no code.
entities: fdir — hardcoded data directory string, L2
m — number of grid points, L4
wid, len — figure size in inches, L18-19
eta — loaded surface elevation snapshot, L25

equations.ref: plane beach shoreward of slope toe

io.name: 4x1 subplot snapshot figure (screen only, no file save)

unresolved: dep=zeros(m)+10.0 (L11) creates an m x m square matrix in MATLAB (zeros with scalar argument), not a length-m vector; L12 then modifies it by logical indexing against the length-m vector x, and plot(x,-dep,...) (L29) receives a matrix — the intended 1-D profile plot depends on this implicit behavior, not clarified in the file
title computes time as files(num)*10 (L35), implying a 10 s output interval for indices [1 6 11 17] (L16); the interval is asserted only here, not read from any input
fdir is a hardcoded developer macOS path (L2) — script is not portable as committed; comment '% wavemaker and sponge' (L14) has no associated code
